title: Gas City ingest authorization (Sam-controlled artifact, single use)

environment.description: staging artifacts authorize staging cities ONLY and are issued by the staging-fixture authority; production artifacts authorize production cities ONLY and are issued by sam.

action.description: Authorizes ONE bead creation in ONE city. Never authorizes sling/dispatch/merge/deploy.

recipient.description: Exact Gas City name the ingest targets. Mismatch refuses.

task_ref.description: Must equal the target finding's task_id. One artifact per task.

issuer.description: Must be 'sam' when environment=production, 'staging-fixture' when environment=staging. Any other issuer refuses.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds; expired artifacts refuse.

max_actions.description: Exactly one ingest per artifact. Single use is enforced by a durable replay-safe ledger; reuse for a different finding refuses.

payload_digest.description: REQUIRED: sha256 of the canonical finding body. Binds the artifact to exact content; omission or mismatch refuses.
